findings.current: Passenger car, Heavy truck, Bus, Trailer

findings.proposed: UN R46 (add R158 optional); drop R125
findings.evidence: UN R125 is forward field of vision of the driver; Article 50 is indirect vision (mirrors / camera monitors), counterpart UN R46. (R125 fits Art 94 instead.)

findings.proposed: UN R158 (reversing motor vehicles) only; drop R159
findings.evidence: UN R159 is the Moving Off Information System (forward close-proximity pedestrian/cyclist detection) for M2/M3/N2/N3, not rear-warning. 'MOIS means a system to detect and inform the driver of pedestrians and cyclists in the close-proximity forward blind-spot'. R158 (reversing) is the correct analogue.
